decisions.reason: Selecting a matcha-oriented whisk style does not change the established bowl capacity, form, or size reference.
The whisk-style decision does not alter the requirement that bowls be quickly removable and swappable.
The source selects a whisk style for fine powder but does not change the existing splash-control target.
The whisk style is an implementation/configuration choice intended to support mixing quality; it does not change the required high-quality, consistently foamy result.
The reference to a matcha whisk has no effect on machine branding, display name, or placard wording.
The selected whisk style does not change the machine's DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The whisk configuration does not modify the spout cleaning or sanitary fluid-path requirements.
Message 46 concerns only the whisk reference; it does not revise the spout's geometry, orientation, appearance, or beverage-quality constraint.
The whisk-style selection does not change the beige and green color scheme.
The source does not change the dispensing valve, closed-valve behavior, or controlled-flow requirements.
Selecting a different whisk style does not alter the plumbing seals or liquid-containment requirements.
The message changes the whisk configuration but does not explicitly or necessarily change the system-layout deliverable or its established design direction.
